messages:
anya ivanova: Heads-up, pulled sora-v2 (q4->q5) into canary for multilingual smoke and seeing locale-specific failures. Overall small delta but the Tibetan+Devanagari mixed lines collapse tokens and Hebrew shows digit-order flips in some outputs. Putting examples here.
chen li: Can you paste the raw pair that shows the digit order flip? Also did tokencounts change?
anya ivanova: Raw minimal repro below. Note the reference keeps logical-order digits but hypothesis is visually mirrored: 
```
ref: עבר 2026/03/19 09:15
hyp: עבר 51:90/6202  <-- digits reversed
```
anya ivanova: For Tibetan+Devanagari mixing here's a bad case where the syllable boundary moves and the devanagari word attaches to preceding tibetan cluster: 
```
ref: སོ་ वाडा
          (tibetan)   (devanagari)
hyp: སོवा་
          (merged incorrectly)
```
rafael cruz: I ran the eval harness locally with quant build: `./eval.sh --model sora-v2 --quant q5 --suites multilingual/mix-v2` -> tib BLEU -3.4, nep -1.9, heb-digit-fail 12/98. Token counts: avg input tokens same but vocab id stream for mixed lines shows different segmentation around U+0F0B (tibetan tsheg) and U+093C mark.
eval-bot: Artifact: s3://redwood-evals/sora-v2/q5/mix-v2/report.html. Metrics: overall BLEU -0.78, tib -3.42, nep -1.91, heb-digit-mirror=12, brack-orient-errs=7. Diffs attached.
chen li: There's a recent tokenizer tweak in main (commit d4f7a2) that changed script-run detection heuristics; also runtime patch (commit c9b8f1) on packing order landed in the same week. Either could be trigger. I'll start a tokenizer-only bisect (fast). Rafael, can you run a quant-runtime bisect in parallel?
rafael cruz: On it. Kicking off kernel bisect across the q5 runtime kernels, will report earliest bad rev. Should have a candidate by EOD.
anya ivanova: Quick experiment: forcing legacy grapheme segmentation in tokenizer (`--tseg-mode=legacy`) reduces tib delta to -0.9 in the smoke harness. Doesn't change heb digit mirroring.
chen li: That suggests tokenization explains tib/dev mix but heb numeric mirror might be downstream (post-process shaping/mirroring or bidi pass). Do we post-process numerals for RTL locales anywhere?
anya ivanova: We do have a bidi-normalize pass in postproc that runs after detokenize for RTL locales. I can repro by piping hypothesis through `postproc --bidi-normalize` and see the mirror. Looks like when numerals are tokenized as independent tokens and then reassembled the order flips under certain combine rules introduced by the new runtime spacer.
infra-bot: Canary rollback triggered: sora-v2-q5-canary rolled back to q4 at 2026-03-21T14:12Z due to regression alert.
chen li: Plan: 1) Tokenizer bisect (anya) to confirm tib. 2) Runtime kernel bisect (rafael) for any changes that affect token joiner spacing. 3) Add small regression tests: heb-digits, tib-dev mix to CI smoke for quant builds. 4) If runtime patch confirmed, either revert packing change or add a postproc guard that preserves numeral logical order before bidi-normalize.
rafael cruz: Kernel bisect found the first bad kernel change at commit c9b8f1 (buffer pack reorder). Reproducer attached.
anya ivanova: Tokenizer bisect returned clean for the heb cases but flagged the tib/dev cases at commit d4f7a2 (script-run heuristic tweak). So two separate issues: tokenizer tweak caused tib/dev attachment, runtime kernel reorder triggered heb digit mirror via changed spacing bytes.
chen li: Ok concrete next steps: revert c9b8f1 in q5 runtime branch and add explicit test that runs `postproc --bidi-preserve-numerals` for heb locale; and revert d4f7a2 or modify script-run rule to not alter boundary at U+0F0B when next char is Devanagari. Create PRs and attach failing examples.
anya ivanova: Filed RED-3301 (tokenizer tweak causing tib-dev merge) and RED-3302 (runtime pack reorder causing heb numeral mirror). Both include smoke reproducer commands and failing pairs.
rafael cruz: After reverting c9b8f1 locally and building q5, heb-digit-fail dropped to 1/98 in smoke. Will prepare rollback PR.
eval-bot: New smoke after local revert: overall BLEU diff -0.05, tib -0.4 (with tokenizer tweak still present), heb-digit-fail 1/98.
chen li: Good. Let's coordinate patch + test merges, then re-run full multilang benchmarks before re-promote. Thanks team.
